Subject: Quick pricing ask — per-1M IO rates + supported models

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking a look — we're evaluating hosted inference vendors for a patient-facing summarization feature and I wanted a straightforward baseline to feed into our cost model. Can you send your standard per-1M token rates split by input vs output for the hosted API (generation/chat), and a short list of the model families you support today (light/medium/heavy or names is fine)? A couple clarifying questions below: 

- Do streaming responses change how you bill (are streamed tokens counted the same as final output tokens)?
- Are there volume tiers or committed discounts you typically offer for a pilot (3 months) vs a production commit?
- Do you publish latency SLOs by model class (p50/p95 for 1-2 request concurrency)?

We expect an initial pilot of ~300k output tokens/month (mostly summary text) and peak spikes during business hours. Curious whether you recommend a reserved pilot or just hosted usage.

If you have a short rate sheet or one-pager, that would be ideal. Can hop on a 20-minute call if easier.

Thanks,
Emma

Hi Emma — great to hear from you and congrats on the project. Below is a concise baseline for hosted API (generation/chat) — happy to schedule a short call to walk through details. I'm including Ben and Aditya for any follow-up on pilot options.

Baseline (hosted API, per 1M tokens) — standard list pricing:
- Redwood-medium: input $0.40 / 1M, output $1.80 / 1M
- Redwood-large: input $0.60 / 1M, output $3.20 / 1M
- Redwood-xl (high-capacity): input $1.10 / 1M, output $6.00 / 1M
- For experimental/open variants (community models) we publish a separate low-cost tier — please ask if you want those rates.

Billing notes:
- Streaming: streamed tokens are billed the same as final output tokens (we count tokens as they are generated).
- Rounding: we bill at 1k-token granularity with per-request aggregation at invoice time.
- Embeddings and reranking use a different per-unit rate; I didn't include those here since your brief was generation.

Pilot/Discounts:
- Standard pilots: we typically offer a 15–25% introductory discount for 1–3 month pilots depending on expected volume and strategic fit.
- Reserved capacity options are available if you want predictable latency and throughput (monthly commit).

Latency SLOs (typical, hosted single-request p50/p95 at 1-2 concurrency, US region):
- Redwood-medium: p50 ~80ms, p95 ~320ms
- Redwood-large: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~480ms
- Redwood-xl: p50 ~260ms, p95 ~980ms

I've attached a short rate sheet (rate_sheet_Q1_2027.pdf) with the full model catalog and a quick comparisons table. If you want, I can put together a pilot SOW that includes a temporary discount and expected billing estimates for the 300k output token scenario you mentioned.

Would you be available for a 20-minute call tomorrow at 10am PT?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
